_readme: Per-layout MazeWalk start/goal in LOGICAL maze cells: [row, col], row 0 = top, col 0 = left (9x9 layouts are 4x4 cells, 15x15 are 7x7). Edit and re-run layout_geometry.py then render_layouts.py. Layouts not listed here use the start/goal stored in layouts/raw. Defaults = ends of each maze's longest shortest path. _domain_L: length of the domain's longer side per family_size (default 1.0); the maze is scaled so passage width = L / logical cells (e.g. 15x15 -> 1.0/7 = 0.143; L = 1.75 would match the 9x9 passage width of 0.25). mazewalk_9x9_mirror2_s0 is derived by make_mirror_layout.py (maze + its mirror image joined by a one-cell bridge); L = 2.25 keeps the 9x9 passage width of 0.25.
